user.title: Connect to 3D Model Manager
user.description: Enter the address of your 3D Model Manager server and an API key with the read scope (add control to operate printers).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {name} was rejected. Enter a new key for the same API key entry.

error.no_printers: No printers are available to this API key.

abort.wrong_key: This API key is a different key than the one configured. Use the original key, or add a new entry.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the server.

missing_control_scope.message: The API key does not have the control scope.

command_failed.message: The command could not be sent to 3D Model Manager.

invalid_api_key.title: 3D Model Manager API key rejected
invalid_api_key.description: The API key for {name} was rejected by the server. Re-authenticate the integration with a valid key.

missing_scope.description: The API key for this server does not have the {scope} scope. Some features are unavailable until you reconfigure the integration with a key that has it.
